coverage.landlord_size_condition: Applies to all landlords, including an owner of a single rental unit in the building where the owner lives.
coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental agreements in Cambridge, including a single residential dwelling unit, and to all tenants and lawful occupants, including tenants at will. Excluded are rental units in hospitals, skilled nursing or health facilities, non-profit short-term substance-abuse treatment facilities, and Short Term Rental Units under Cambridge Zoning Ordinance Art. 4, § 4.60.
coverage.other_conditions: Excludes Short Term Rental Units under Cambridge Zoning Ordinance Art. 4, § 4.60, and rental units in hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, health facilities and non-profit short-term substance-abuse treatment facilities.

result.notes: Removed from the summary the statement that the rule applies in addition to the state form under G.L. c. 186, § 31. No document supports it. Set requires_unknown_facts to false because the ordinance covers ordinary residential rentals, including a single unit. Expanded unverifiable_exemptions to list all three exclusions: hospital, skilled nursing or health facility units; non-profit substance-abuse facility units; and registered short-term rental units. An address or assessor lookup cannot reliably confirm any of them. There is no owner-occupied exemption: an owner-occupant renting one unit is covered. No unit-count, construction-date or preemption terms appear in the documents.
